QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Eye Drops
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann almost burst into tears but then his eyeballs would have popped.

0.0: Goodness gracious, my allergies are just killing me! I feel like my eyeballs are shrivelling up into little raisins of blindness!

no.0: Are YOUR eyes okay, #b#h0##k? You must have a lot of moisture on those peepers!

1.0: Eye drops! Finally! I swear, I thought the vultures were going to come down here and just pluck these shriveled little jelly-bags out of my skull.
